text:
maya-partners: Quick heads-up — kickoff for a cross-cloud SKU consistency + private-offer pilot across AWS/GCP/Azure. Core asks: legal signoff for private offers, canonical SKU mapping, telemetry hooks for usage metering, and a clear SI/reseller path. Meeting 11:00am PT. Prep below.

priya-product: I can consolidate bundle defs. Can someone drop the latest SKU export? need entitlements + trial flags.

tom-ops: Pushed current region/AMI list to the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace/region-ami-matrix. Also we need account IDs for private-offer activation (aws/gcp billing project). @liam-legal can you confirm contract template we should use for private offers?

liam-legal: Will review. Q: are we offering SI/reseller discounts in this pilot or just direct private offers? If SI discounts are needed we should add an addendum which adds ~3 business days. Ill upload a draft contract by EOD: https://drive.redwood/legal/private-offer-draft-v1.docx 

jordan-sre: Telemetry note: billing needs near-real-time meter events. Proposed ingest path: /internal/marketplace/ingest/v2 -> Kafka -> billing worker. Need sample payload and a test harness. Example payload:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct-1234",
  "product_sku": "RED-CORE-XL-v1",
  "cloud": "aws",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "tokens": 342,
  "timestamp": "2024-04-16T18:02:31Z"
}
```
Can someone confirm the field names we want in the contract?

marketplace-bot: Created ticket MP-1129 (cross-cloud-sku-pilot). Assignees: @maya-partners @priya-product @tom-ops @liam-legal @jordan-sre. https://jira.redwood/MP-1129 

maya-partners: Thanks. Priya — prefer canonical mapping format: `product_id|cloud_offer_id|trial:boolean|tier|si_eligible:boolean`. Put as CSV so partner teams can ingest.

priya-product: Dropping a small sample CSV here: 
```
product_id,cloud_offer_id,trial,tier,si_eligible
red-core-xl,aws:rd-core-xl-1,true,enterprise,true
gpt-embed-lite,gcp:embed-lite-2024,false,starter,false
```
Should we include SKU-level pricing override column for private offers?

tom-ops: Add columns `private_offer_enabled` and `kms_key_alias`. Ops checklist I'm assembling: AMI IDs per region, network egress rules, IAM role names (MarketplaceDeployRole), KMS key aliases, and account numbers for private-offer activation. Note: not all regions have the same GPU families — include a fallback offer and a region-note in listing.

liam-legal: OK adding `pricing_override` and `si_addendum_required` flags to the template. If a partner requests reseller terms mark `si_addendum_required=true`. I'll add a short clause for telemetry/data retention (30 days for metering payloads) unless security requests otherwise.

maya-partners: Action summary: Priya send full CSV by 10:30am PT, Tom publish ops checklist + account numbers by EOD, Liam upload legal draft by EOD, Jordan provide test harness + sample curl to MP-1129 by tomorrow. We'll review live at 11. :rocket:
